phases.title: Python & Mathematics Foundations
phases.summary: Establish rock-solid programming discipline and mathematical intuitions for machine learning algorithms.
phases.objectives: Establish rock-solid programming discipline and mathematical intuitions for machine learning algorithms.
phases.topicsOutline: Python data structures, OOP, Exceptions, Typing, JSON/APIs, File I/O, Git/GitHub, Linux CLI, Linear Algebra (Vectors, Matrices, Dot Products), Probability & Statistics, Derivatives & Gradient Descent.
phases.exercise:
1. Implement matrix multiplication from scratch without NumPy.
2. Write gradient descent optimization for 2D function.
3. Build CLI tool with API fetching and JSON caching.
phases.deliverable: GitHub repo with clean Python utilities, math scratch notebooks, unit tests with pytest.
phases.successCriteria: Pass self-assessment test: explain eigenvalues, dot products, and write OOP Python classes with type hints and tests without reference.
phases.recommendedResources: Python Docs, 3Blue1Brown Essense of Linear Algebra, Khan Academy Statistics

phases.title: Data Analysis & Traditional Machine Learning
phases.summary: Master data preprocessing, feature engineering, and classical machine learning algorithms with scikit-learn.
phases.objectives: Master data preprocessing, feature engineering, and classical machine learning algorithms with scikit-learn.
phases.topicsOutline: NumPy array operations, Pandas DataFrames, Data Cleaning, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Matplotlib/Seaborn, Supervised Learning (Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, XGBoost), Unsupervised Learning (K-Means, PCA), Overfitting, Cross-validation, Precision/Recall/F1, Data Leakage.
phases.exercise:
1. Customer churn prediction with XGBoost.
2. B2B Sales transaction exploratory data analysis.
3. Implement Logistic Regression from scratch.
phases.deliverable: Project 1: Sales Data Analysis & Project 2: Customer Purchase Prediction Model with full EDA notebook and metrics report.
phases.successCriteria: Achieve F1 > 0.82 on test split; demonstrate understanding of bias-variance tradeoff and confusion matrix.
phases.recommendedResources: Google ML Crash Course, scikit-learn User Guide, Pandas official docs

phases.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
phases.summary: Build intuition for neural network architectures, backpropagation, and tensor computing with PyTorch.
phases.objectives: Build intuition for neural network architectures, backpropagation, and tensor computing with PyTorch.
phases.topicsOutline: Tensors, Autograd, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP), Activation Functions (ReLU, GELU, Softmax), Loss Functions (MSE, Cross-Entropy), Optimizers (SGD, AdamW), PyTorch Dataset/DataLoader, Regularization (Dropout, Weight Decay), Convolutional & Sequence Networks, Embeddings.
phases.exercise:
1. Build micrograd / mini autograd engine in Python.
2. Train PyTorch neural network for customer intent classification.
3. Implement custom PyTorch Dataset for tabular/text data.
phases.deliverable: Project 3: Customer Message Intent Classification model trained and evaluated in PyTorch.
phases.successCriteria: Explain backpropagation forward/backward pass mathematics on whiteboard; train stable PyTorch model without overfitting.
phases.recommendedResources: PyTorch Official Tutorials, fast.ai Practical Deep Learning, Andrej Karpathy nn-zero-to-hero

phases.title: LLM Fundamentals & Transformer Architecture
phases.summary: Understand how Large Language Models work internally from tokenization to attention mechanisms.
phases.objectives: Understand how Large Language Models work internally from tokenization to attention mechanisms.
phases.topicsOutline: Tokenization (BPE, WordPiece, tiktoken), Transformer Architecture (Encoder, Decoder, Encoder-Decoder), Scaled Dot-Product Attention, Multi-Head Attention, Positional Encodings, Pretraining Objectives, Causal Masking, Context Windows, KV Caching, Quantization (GGUF, AWQ, bitsandbytes).
phases.exercise:
1. Build self-attention and multi-head attention module in PyTorch.
2. Tokenize text using tiktoken and examine token distributions.
3. Run local quantized Llama-3 model using llama.cpp / Ollama.
phases.deliverable: Clean PyTorch notebook with annotated Transformer attention layer and local inference benchmark script.
phases.successCriteria: Explain scaled dot-product attention equation QK^T / sqrt(d_k) and KV caching latency trade-offs without consulting notes.
phases.recommendedResources: Attention Is All You Need paper, Hugging Face NLP Course, Jay Alammar The Illustrated Transformer

phases.title: Prompt Engineering & LLM App Development
phases.summary: Master programmatic interactions with state-of-the-art LLMs using official APIs, structured outputs, and evaluation.
phases.objectives: Master programmatic interactions with state-of-the-art LLMs using official APIs, structured outputs, and evaluation.
phases.topicsOutline: System Prompts, In-Context Learning, Few-shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Structured Outputs (JSON Schema / Pydantic validation), OpenAI & Gemini APIs, Error handling & retries, Token management & Cost optimization, Prompt injection defenses.
phases.exercise:
1. Build B2B lead enrichment pipeline extracting structured JSON from raw company websites.
2. Implement robust retry with exponential backoff for rate limits.
3. Benchmark prompt variants across 50 test leads.
phases.deliverable: Structured extraction library with Pydantic models, JSON schema validation, and token cost counter.
phases.successCriteria: 100% valid JSON output compliance over 100 test cases using native structured output modes.
phases.recommendedResources: OpenAI Structured Outputs Guide, Gemini API Cookbook, Anthropic Prompt Engineering Interactive Tutorial

phases.title: Embeddings, Vector Databases & RAG
phases.summary: Construct enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines grounded in private product documentation.
phases.objectives: Construct enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines grounded in private product documentation.
phases.topicsOutline: Embedding models (text-embedding-3, BGE, Voyage), Chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, recursive, markdown), Vector similarity (Cosine, Dot Product), Vector databases (ChromaDB, pgvector), Hybrid Search (Dense + Sparse BM25), Reranking (Cohere, Cross-Encoder), Grounding & Citations, RAG Evaluation (RAGAS / TruLens).
phases.exercise:
1. Build document ingestion pipeline with semantic chunking.
2. Set up PostgreSQL with pgvector for persistent vector search.
3. Implement hybrid search with cross-encoder reranking.
phases.deliverable: Project 4: Enterprise Product Knowledge Assistant using RAG with citation grounding and evaluation notebook.
phases.successCriteria: Zero hallucination on factual product specifications; retrieval precision > 88% on domain test benchmark.
phases.recommendedResources: LangChain / LlamaIndex docs, Pinecone Learning Center, pgvector documentation

phases.title: AI Agent Fundamentals & Tool Calling
phases.summary: Learn core agentic patterns: reasoning loops, tool calling schemas, environment execution, and state persistence.
phases.objectives: Learn core agentic patterns: reasoning loops, tool calling schemas, environment execution, and state persistence.
phases.topicsOutline: Agent Architectures (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, Reflection), Function Calling / Tool Calling schemas, Tool argument validation with Pydantic, Memory design (short-term buffer, long-term vector/SQL), Execution sandboxing, State persistence, Error recovery & tool retries.
phases.prerequisites: Phase 5 & 6: Structured Outputs, LLM APIs, Vector Stores
phases.exercise:
1. Build ReAct agent loop from scratch in pure Python.
2. Equip agent with tools: web search, calculator, SQL query, CRM contact lookup.
3. Implement persistent SQLite session state.
phases.deliverable: Project 5: Tool-Using Autonomous Research Agent capable of multi-step company research.
phases.successCriteria: Agent successfully completes 3-step tool chains with proper parameter passing and zero execution crashes.
phases.recommendedResources: OpenAI Function Calling Guide, Anthropic Building Effective Agents, LangGraph official tutorials

phases.title: Agent Orchestration & Multi-Agent Systems
phases.summary: Orchestrate complex workflows, human-in-the-loop approvals, and specialized multi-agent collaboration.
phases.objectives: Orchestrate complex workflows, human-in-the-loop approvals, and specialized multi-agent collaboration.
phases.topicsOutline: State Graphs with LangGraph, Multi-Agent patterns (Supervisor, Hierarchical, Peer-to-Peer), CrewAI framework, Conditional routing, Dynamic replanning, Human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints & approval gates, Guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard), Context distillation.
phases.exercise:
1. Build a LangGraph workflow with human-approval checkpoint before sending email.
2. Create 3-agent team: Lead Researcher, Email Drafter, Quality Reviewer.
3. Implement fallback routing when primary tool fails.
phases.deliverable: Project 6: Lead Qualification & Scoring Agent + Project 9: Collaborative Multi-Agent Sales Workflow.
phases.successCriteria: Multi-agent workflow handles unexpected tool failure gracefully and pauses execution for human approval on high-value actions.
phases.recommendedResources: LangGraph Documentation, CrewAI Masterclass, Llama Guard docs

phases.title: AI Sales Agent Development (Autonomous Sales Employee)
phases.summary: Synthesize all agentic capabilities into a dedicated, commercial-grade AI Sales Employee.
phases.objectives: Synthesize all agentic capabilities into a dedicated, commercial-grade AI Sales Employee.
phases.topicsOutline: 12 Core Capabilities: Prospecting, BANT Lead Scoring, Consultative Needs Discovery, Multi-channel Communication (Email/Chat/WhatsApp), Knowledge RAG, Price Negotiation within business guardrails, Automated Follow-up sequences, PDF Quotation generation, CRM synchronization (HubSpot/Postgres), Analytics logging, Human escalation triggers.
phases.exercise:
1. Build BANT scoring engine that scores leads from conversation transcripts.
2. Implement price negotiation agent with strict discount ceilings.
3. Connect agent to WhatsApp Business sandbox and SendGrid email API.
phases.deliverable: Project 7: AI Sales Employee with Follow-ups & Project 8: AI Negotiation and Quotation Assistant.
phases.successCriteria: End-to-end simulated customer engagement: agent researches lead, answers questions from RAG, qualifies budget, negotiates price within policy, and outputs signed quote.
phases.recommendedResources: HubSpot API Docs, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Docs, ReportLab PDF documentation

phases.title: Model Fine-Tuning & Customization
phases.summary: Master when and how to fine-tune open-weight and proprietary models for domain-specific sales style and cost reduction.
phases.objectives: Master when and how to fine-tune open-weight and proprietary models for domain-specific sales style and cost reduction.
phases.topicsOutline: When to Prompt vs RAG vs Fine-tune, Dataset preparation & formatting (ShareGPT, Alpaca, JSONL), Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) with TRL / Unsloth, Evaluation with benchmark test suites, Model merging and GGUF export.
phases.prerequisites: Phase 4 & Phase 3: PyTorch, Transformer basics, Quantization
phases.exercise:
1. Format 500 sales objection-handling pairs into JSONL.
2. Fine-tune Llama-3-8B with QLoRA using Unsloth on Google Colab / Lambda Labs.
3. Compare fine-tuned model vs prompt-engineered base model on benchmark set.
phases.deliverable: Fine-tuned specialized sales objection-handling adapter, training loss curves, and evaluation comparison report.
phases.successCriteria: Fine-tuned model achieves > 92% adherence to company sales methodology with 3x lower inference cost than frontier APIs.
phases.recommendedResources: Hugging Face PEFT & TRL docs, Unsloth documentation, Axolotl GitHub

phases.title: Production Deployment, Security & Monitoring
phases.summary: Engineer reliable, secure, containerized cloud infrastructure for real business usage.
phases.objectives: Engineer reliable, secure, containerized cloud infrastructure for real business usage.
phases.topicsOutline: FastAPI async backend, Docker containerization, PostgreSQL database design, Redis message queuing & background tasks, Authentication & API keys, Observability (LangSmith / OpenLLMetry / Arize Phoenix), Rate limiting & token quotas, Security (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, Prompt Injection, Data Leakage).
phases.exercise:
1. Dockerize full agent system with docker-compose (FastAPI, Redis, Postgres, pgvector).
2. Instrument agent with OpenTelemetry tracing and LangSmith dashboard.
3. Add prompt injection sanitization layer and rate limiter.
phases.deliverable: Project 10: Production-Ready AI Sales Platform deployed on Render / Hetzner with healthchecks and monitoring.
phases.successCriteria: Server maintains 99.5% uptime under simulated load test; zero token quota leaks; full trace visibility on all agent decisions.
phases.recommendedResources: Docker Docs, FastAPI Production Guide, OWASP LLM Top 10, LangSmith Docs

phases.title: Advanced AI Engineering & Commercialization
phases.summary: Package, market, and commercially sell specialized AI agents to business clients.
phases.objectives: Package, market, and commercially sell specialized AI agents to business clients.
phases.topicsOutline: Product-Market Fit for AI agents, Commercial pricing models (per-agent seat vs usage/success fee), Client onboarding workflows, Multi-tenant data segregation, Sales demos & interactive landing pages, SLA definitions, Customer feedback loops, Maintenance & ongoing agent retraining.

phases.deliverable: Live commercial offering: Landing page, documentation, interactive sales demo, and validated pricing packages.
phases.successCriteria: Secure at least 1 pilot business customer or formal letter of intent (LOI) to deploy AI Sales Employee.
phases.recommendedResources: Y Combinator Startup School, Stripe Billing Docs, Commercial Product Validation Sheet

resources.title: Google Machine Learning Crash Course
resources.notes: Google · Machine Learning. Learn foundational ML concepts, gradient descent, loss functions, classification, and neural network intuitions. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Complete all embedded Colab exercises and model tuning tasks.

resources.title: Google Foundational ML & Data Prep Courses
resources.notes: Google · Data Engineering. Master data transformation, feature scaling, numerical bucketing, categorical encoding, and handling missing values. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Clean an uncurated customer dataset and transform features for regression modeling.

resources.title: Google Gemini API Documentation
resources.notes: Google · LLM APIs. Learn Gemini model families (Flash, Pro), multimodal inputs, system instructions, safety settings, and token limits. Access: Free / Freemium.
resources.takeaways: Build a Python client calling Gemini-1.5-Flash with custom safety thresholds and system prompt.

resources.title: Google Gemini API Cookbook
resources.notes: Google · LLM Applications. Practical recipe code for RAG, function calling, structured extraction, audio/video analysis, and document reasoning. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Implement the official function calling and structured JSON output notebook recipes.

resources.title: OpenAI Developer Platform Documentation
resources.notes: OpenAI · LLM APIs. Understand Chat Completions, context windows, seed parameters, role system, streaming responses, and token usage. Access: Paid API.
resources.takeaways: Create multi-turn chat wrapper handling token limits and streaming outputs to terminal.

resources.title: OpenAI Function Calling Guide
resources.notes: OpenAI · AI Agents. Learn strict tool schemas, parallel tool calls, tool choice parameters, and executing function responses. Access: Paid API.
resources.takeaways: Build agent with 3 simulated business tools: CRM lookup, inventory query, discount calculator.

resources.title: OpenAI Structured Outputs Guide
resources.notes: OpenAI · LLM Applications. Master 100% reliable schema adherence with constrained decoding and native Pydantic integration. Access: Paid API.
resources.takeaways: Extract validated lead BANT qualification objects directly from messy sales call transcripts.

resources.title: OpenAI Retrieval, Evals & Agent Building Guide
resources.notes: OpenAI · Evaluation & Agents. Learn rigorous LLM evaluation methodologies, synthetic dataset creation, and agent benchmarking. Access: Free / Paid API.
resources.takeaways: Build an automated evaluation pipeline measuring sales agent response accuracy against 30 gold standards.

resources.title: Meta Llama Documentation & Model Card
resources.notes: Meta · Open-Weight LLMs. Understand Llama-3 architecture, tokenizer nuances, prompt formatting, context window expansion, and licensing terms. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Download and verify Llama-3-8B weights on Ubuntu Linux environment.

resources.title: Meta Llama Cookbook
resources.notes: Meta · LLM Engineering. Production code for local inference with vLLM/Ollama, fine-tuning with PEFT, synthetic data, and RAG pipelines. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Run end-to-end local RAG pipeline with Llama-3-8B and ChromaDB.

resources.title: Meta Llama Fine-Tuning & Quantization Guide
resources.notes: Meta · Fine-Tuning. Learn LoRA, QLoRA, FSDP distributed training, and quantizing Llama models for high-throughput inference. Access: Free (Compute Req).
resources.takeaways: Fine-tune Llama-3-8B on an objection-handling dataset using QLoRA.

resources.title: Hugging Face NLP Course
resources.notes: Hugging Face · NLP & Transformers. Master Transformers from scratch, tokenizers, pipeline API, fine-tuning with Trainer, and evaluation metrics. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Fine-tune a DistilBERT text classification model for customer email urgency detection.

resources.title: Hugging Face Transformers Documentation
resources.notes: Hugging Face · Transformers. Comprehensive API reference for model loading, quantization configurations (bitsandbytes, AWQ), generation parameters. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Write custom generation loop with temperature, top_p, and stop token controls.

resources.title: PyTorch Official Tutorials (Deep Learning with PyTorch)
resources.notes: PyTorch · Deep Learning. Learn tensors, autograd, nn.Module, Dataset/DataLoader, optimizers, and model saving/loading. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Build and train a 3-layer neural network from scratch on custom tabular sales data.

resources.title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders (Part 1 & 2)
resources.notes: fast.ai · Deep Learning. Top-down, code-first introduction to deep learning, training dynamics, transfer learning, and model debugging. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Train an image classifier and tabular prediction model using fastai/PyTorch.

resources.title: scikit-learn Official User Guide
resources.notes: scikit-learn · Machine Learning. In-depth documentation of linear models, trees, ensembles, clustering, preprocessing pipelines, and cross-validation. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Build a production Scikit-Learn Pipeline combining ColumnTransformer and RandomForestClassifier.

resources.title: Python 3 Official Documentation & Typing Guide
resources.notes: Python.org · Programming. Master data models, OOP, async io, typing module (TypeVar, Protocol), and exception hierarchies. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Write an asynchronous task worker with typed protocol interfaces and custom exception handlers.

resources.title: NumPy Official Documentation & Quickstart
resources.notes: NumPy · Scientific Computing. Master multi-dimensional arrays, indexing, slicing, vectorization, linear algebra routines, and broadcasting. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Implement cosine similarity and matrix multiplication from scratch using NumPy arrays.

resources.title: Pandas Official Documentation & User Guide
resources.notes: Pandas · Data Analysis. DataFrames, Series, merging, indexing, time series, aggregation, and handling dirty business data. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Load 50,000 CRM rows, clean timestamps, engineer lead velocity features, and export clean CSV.

resources.title: LangGraph Documentation & Agent Tutorials
resources.notes: LangChain · AI Agents. Learn state graphs, cyclical agent loops, persistence, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and multi-agent coordination. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Build stateful sales qualification graph with conditional routing and human approval pauses.

resources.title: CrewAI Official Documentation
resources.notes: CrewAI · Multi-Agent. Role-based autonomous multi-agent teams, task delegation, shared memory, and tools. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Create a 3-agent team: Lead Researcher, Pitch Drafter, and QA Auditor.

resources.title: FastAPI Official Documentation
resources.notes: FastAPI · Backend Engineering. Async API design, Pydantic validation, dependency injection, OpenAPI documentation, and background tasks. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Build production webhook API endpoint receiving messages, invoking agent graph, and returning async response.

resources.title: PostgreSQL & pgvector Official Documentation
resources.notes: pgvector / PostgreSQL · Database & Vectors. Vector storage in relational DBs, IVFFlat and HNSW indexes, hybrid SQL + vector queries. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Write SQL query combining metadata filtering (customer_industry='SaaS') with vector cosine similarity.

resources.title: Docker Documentation & Container Best Practices
resources.notes: Docker · DevOps & Deployment. Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, non-root user security, docker-compose orchestration, environment variables. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Create multi-container docker-compose stack running FastAPI, PostgreSQL pgvector, and Redis.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
resources.notes: OWASP · AI Security. Prompt injection, insecure output handling, training data poisoning, model denial of service, excessive agency. Access: Free.
resources.takeaways: Audit your sales agent against all 10 vulnerabilities and implement sanitization & tool permission boundaries.

projects.title: Sales Data Analysis & Customer Segmentation
projects.description:
Sales teams lack visibility into which customer segments generate the highest lifetime value and have the shortest sales cycles.

Acceptance criteria: Clean reproducible Jupyter notebook producing RFM segments, visual charts, and actionable sales recommendations without execution errors.
Testing requirements: Pytest asserting data cleaning functions handle NaNs and duplicate transaction IDs properly.
Target date from workbook: 2026-12-20
projects.knownLimitations: Missing transaction records and dirty timestamp formats in real-world CRM extracts.

projects.title: Customer Purchase Prediction Model
projects.description:
Sales reps waste 60% of their time calling cold leads who have almost zero probability of purchasing enterprise software.

Acceptance criteria: Classifier achieves ROC-AUC > 0.85 and Precision > 75% on held-out test split, outperforming naive baseline by 3x.
Testing requirements: Cross-validation verification asserting zero feature leakage between train and test folds.
Target date from workbook: 2026-12-31
projects.knownLimitations: Overfitting to historical data due to shifting customer behavior seasonality.

tasks.title: Address class imbalance with SMOTE/class weights.

projects.title: Customer Message Intent & Urgency Classifier
projects.description:
Customer inquiries arrive in high volume across email and chat without automated routing to appropriate specialists.

Acceptance criteria: Model achieves Macro F1 > 0.84 across 5 intent classes on 1,000 test messages.
Testing requirements: Unit tests asserting model handles empty strings, emojis, and very long text inputs gracefully.
Target date from workbook: 2027-01-25
projects.knownLimitations: Ambiguous multi-intent messages (e.g. asking both about pricing and filing a technical bug).

tasks.title: Implement PyTorch MLP with embedding layer.

projects.title: Product Knowledge Assistant using RAG
projects.description:
Sales reps and potential buyers struggle to find accurate technical specifications and pricing details buried in 200-page product catalogs.

Acceptance criteria: Answers factual product questions with 100% citation accuracy; refuses out-of-domain questions with zero hallucination.
Testing requirements: Automated test suite using RAGAS asserting Faithfulness > 0.90 and Answer Relevance > 0.88.
Target date from workbook: 2027-04-20
projects.knownLimitations: Chunk boundary splitting that separates pricing table headers from price values.

projects.title: Tool-Using Autonomous Research Agent
projects.description:
Pre-call prospect research requires manual searching across LinkedIn, Google, company websites, and CRM systems, taking 30 minutes per lead.

Acceptance criteria: Agent independently executes 3-4 tool calls in sequence to research an unfamiliar company and outputs complete structured lead profile.
Testing requirements: Mocked API tests verifying tool call failure recovery and circuit breaking after 5 iterations.
Target date from workbook: 2027-05-25
projects.knownLimitations: Infinite loops when LLM cannot find answer from web search results.

tasks.title: Build autonomous ReAct loop with max iteration limits.

projects.title: Lead Qualification & BANT Scoring Agent
projects.description:
Inbound leads receive generic follow-ups because sales teams cannot interview every prospect to establish Budget, Authority, Need, and Timing.

Acceptance criteria: Agent sustains multi-turn conversation, gathers all 4 BANT criteria without sounding robotic, and calculates accurate qualification score.
Testing requirements: Simulated conversation test suite running 20 distinct buyer personas through qualification flow.
Target date from workbook: 2027-06-25
projects.knownLimitations: Prospects resisting budget questions or giving evasive answers.

projects.title: Autonomous AI Sales Employee with Follow-ups
projects.description:
Over 70% of sales opportunities die from poor follow-up cadence; human reps forget to follow up after the first email or message.

Acceptance criteria: System executes timed follow-up sequences across 10 simulated leads, pauses immediately when a reply is detected, and updates CRM status.
Testing requirements: Integration tests verifying webhook reply triggers cancellation of future queued follow-up tasks.
Target date from workbook: 2027-07-31
projects.knownLimitations: Deliverability and spam filtering risks with automated email sequences.

tasks.title: Implement webhook handlers for message replies.
Integrate SendGrid and WhatsApp Cloud APIs.

projects.title: AI Price Negotiation & Quotation Generator Assistant
projects.description:
Custom sales quoting takes hours of manual back-and-forth; sales reps often offer unauthorized discounts or make pricing calculation errors.

Acceptance criteria: Agent negotiates within authorized bounds, produces a clean, professional PDF quote, and emails it to the buyer with an active payment link.
Testing requirements: 100 automated adversarial tests confirming the agent never agrees to discounts exceeding business policy.
Target date from workbook: 2027-08-15
projects.knownLimitations: Adversarial prompt injection attacks where buyers convince the LLM to give 90% discounts.

tasks.title: Connect quote generation tool to agent.

projects.title: Collaborative Multi-Agent Sales Team
projects.description:
Complex enterprise sales require specialized roles: SDR for prospecting, Solution Engineer for technical Q&A, and Account Executive for closing.

Acceptance criteria: Multi-agent team collaboratively handles lead from first touch through technical product inquiry to final contract quotation seamlessly.
Testing requirements: End-to-end integration tests measuring token efficiency and inter-agent latency.
Target date from workbook: 2027-08-31
projects.knownLimitations: Token explosion and latency compounding across multiple sequential LLM calls.

tasks.title: Define individual agent personas and system prompts.
Implement supervisor routing node in LangGraph.
Run full enterprise sales cycle simulation.

projects.title: Production-Ready AI Sales Platform (Commercial MVP)
projects.description:
Commercial businesses require a secure, multi-tenant, monitored web platform with human-in-the-loop oversight to safely deploy AI sales reps.

Acceptance criteria: Fully working commercial platform deployed online; handles live chats, executes tool calls, allows human intervention, and logs all metrics reliably.
Testing requirements: End-to-end Cypress/Playwright frontend tests, Locust load testing (50 concurrent users), and OWASP security vulnerability scan.
Target date from workbook: 2027-10-15
projects.knownLimitations: Cold start latency on cloud hosts and managing API key rate limits under peak load.

Deploy to Render with persistent disk & PostgreSQL.
